name: main_P2_recipe
_comment: JOB E staged run. Recipe = pilot arm P2 (lowest selection loss by the rule fixed before the pilots): Adam, batch 8192, peak lr 5e-4, 500 warm-up steps, cosine to 5 % per stage, alpha 0.25 constant (target = 0.75 * sigmoid(score * 2.25 / 400) + 0.25 * result), natural sampling (one permutation per epoch). Stage ends are cumulative presentations including the 761,856,000 of the FB2 warm start. S5 and S6 were added at 17:55 on 2026-11-11, before any staged result, after throughput measured 2.0M positions/s; they run only while the stop rule allows.

stop_rule.metric: select_2m mse_b0.6 at stage ends; reference_metric = FB2 best net on the same set
